subject: Financial Markets Management
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Communication Skills-III in CBSE Class 11 Financial Markets Management.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Financial Markets Management (805), Unit-1: Communication Skills-III covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.

subject: Financial Markets Management
instruction: Generate a CBSE board-style step-by-step marking rubric and evaluation criteria for a problem based on White/Black Boards in Class 11 Financial Markets Management.
